title: Grab the M5 MacBook Air with 1TB of storage and save $150
content:
Macworld

Save $150 ion Apple MacBook Air M5

View Deal

If you’ve been putting off a laptop upgrade because prices are just too high these days, here’s the deal you’ve been waiting for. The M5 MacBook Air is down to $1,449 at Amazon, a clean $150 off its usual $1,599. This looks like it’s going to be the best discount we’ll get for a long while, at least until Black Friday.

The M5 chip and its speedy 16GB of unified memory keep things smooth whether you’re juggling a few dozen browser tabs, editing photos, or bouncing between apps. It can handle creative work just fine and will do well with AI tasks too, without breaking a sweat. Battery life is where the Air truly shines because, as slim as this laptop is, you get up to 18 hours on a single charge. Therefore, you don’t have to carry the power brick with you everywhere you go, which is always nice. It’s also got a super-fast SSD that will make the whole machine feel even faster.

The 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display looks gorgeous, and it makes photos, videos, and text look crisp and vivid. Throw in the 12MP Center Stage camera, and you know you’ll be in frame during every video call you take. Add Apple Intelligence for effortless writing help, two Thunderbolt 4 ports, MagSafe charging, and Wi-Fi 7, and you’ve got a setup that just works.

For $1,449, this Apple MacBook Air M5 is an easy pick if you want a light, everyday laptop that lasts all day.
